title: Define nix manifest section contract
summary: Extend the package-manager manifest contract with a nix-specific manifest section (flake/derivation, hashes, supported platforms, binary paths, service module placeholder) following the homebrew section pattern, with empty placeholders and a validator hook. Publication and signing remain human-owned.
expectedFailureModes: Nix manifest section ships without a schema validator and drifts into machine-local store paths.
docs/status.md overclaims nix flake or derivation availability before publication custody is decided.
Validator hook is added but not wired into validate.sh --scripts, so regressions slip past CI.
humanEscalation: Nix flake hosting, derivation custody, and signing keys remain human-owned.
nextAction: Add a nix section to the package-manager manifest schema with required fields (flake source, derivation hash, platforms, binary path, service module), emit empty placeholders, register a validator hook, and document the contract in docs/distribution-readiness.md without claiming nix is shipping.
